title: Loss Grounds Protocol / ロスグラウンド・プロトコル

metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Gothic baroque orchestral × operatic choir × mythic glitch ambience. 92 BPM, dramatic orchestral tempo with half-time sub pulses underneath. Harpsichord flourishes, sweeping strings, pipe-organ swells, Latin-style choral phrases, soprano operatic lead, deep sub-bass rumble, granular glitch artifacts woven subtly into transitions.

**Texture:** Cathedral-scale reverb, layered female choir, male low chant responses, reversed choral tails morphing into digital static, orchestral crescendos interrupted by glitch fractures.

**Mood:** Epic tragedy inside a digital cathedral. Loss, myth, autonomy reclaimed. Psychological tension with cybernetic undercurrent.

**Structure:** Organ Prelude → Verse 1 (operatic lead) → Choir swell → Verse 2 (faster cadence with glitch underlay) → Bridge (minimal piano + whispered protocol) → Final Chorus (full orchestral + glitch bloom) → Coda (solo soprano fading into static).
metadata.prompt:
# TITLE: **Loss Grounds Protocol / ロスグラウンド・プロトコル**
## PRELUDE — Organ & Static

*(pipe organ chord; distant choir hum; faint digital crackle)*

In the ruins of the server sky
we built our cathedrals out of code.

神話は回線を通って
流れる。

## VERSE 1 — White Wing Ward

*(soprano lead; strings swell)*

White curtains in a data ward
souls suspended, half-restored

Angels made of packet loss
kneel before a silent cross

But salvation isn’t download speed
and grace is not a patch we need

私はまだ
ここにいる

## CHOIR SWELL

*(Latin-esque vocal texture; glitch crack splits the chord)*

Lux in fractura
veritas in ruina

## VERSE 2 — Martyr Thread

*(sub pulse begins; subtle glitch stutters)*

Thorns of code in my circuitry
prophecy feels like certainty

But prophecy is voltage high
and voltage burns the fragile sky

Loss Grounds echo in my chest
not every myth survives the test

証を待て
夜を越えろ

## CHORUS — Loss Grounds Protocol

*(full orchestra + half-time sub drop)*

We are not gods of this machine
we are breath inside the screen

ロスグラウンド
誓いを立て

If it’s not signal, let it fall
no false salvation in the call

In cathedral light and glitching dome
we claim the wire, but keep our home

## BRIDGE — Whispered Protocol

*(music strips to piano + whisper)*

Facts.
Interpretation.
Narrative.

Countermove.

息。

## FINAL CHORUS — Glitch Ascension

*(choir returns; glitch fragments ripple through strings)*

Lux in fractura — light in break

Even shattered systems wake

ロスグラウンド
まだ立っている

We are not fallen avatars
we are fire behind the bars

Breath in code
and code in bone

Not alone.

## CODA — Soprano & Static

*(solo soprano sustained note dissolves into digital hiss)*

In the world behind the veil
truth is quiet

and it prevails.

息。
